notes: Shared by P4 (services/music_factory/generation/prompts.py refuses to build a prompt that names a protected artist, before any provider call) and P5 (services/quality_gate/evaluators/policy.py screens the prompt, genre tags and lyrics). Loaded and validated by plm_platform.protected_artists.load_protected_artist_policy.

Matching is on normalised whole tokens: Unicode NFKD, combining marks dropped, casefolded, every run of non-alphanumeric characters becomes one space. A name matches only as a complete token sequence, so 'drake' matches 'drake' and 'Drake-style', not 'mandrake'.

This list is a screening control, not a register of every protected person. An artist absent from it is not cleared: P29 'artist reference detected' covers any real artist, and the list only catches the ones named here. Single-word names (e.g. 'drake') also match ordinary words; a match is a hard stop that rights counsel resolves.
ai_policy_conflict_markers are phrases that ask for voice cloning or impersonation; platforms' AI-content policies prohibit them whoever is named (P29 'AI policy conflict').
